# Catando

> Catando is a free, calm logic puzzle for iOS (17 or later). Fill a grid with cats and dogs so every row and column balances, no three alike sit in a line, and every hint between tiles checks out. Every puzzle is solvable by logic alone — no guessing, no timer, no account.

## Key facts
- Platform: iOS 17 or later
- Price: free to play, ad-supported; a one-time Remove Ads purchase is available
- Modes: Daily Puzzle (same grid for everyone, streak with one grace day), Stage Mode (4x4 up to 10x10), Practice (any size, hints and undo)
- Progress dashboard with 10 badges
- Account: none required
- Developer: Kairos AI Tech
